question:

Benchmark knowledge evidence: super power of "Super Strength" refers to power_name = 'Super Strength'; a height of over 200cm refers to height_cm > 200

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.XCL_013 = sp.XCL_030
WHERE sp.XCL_031 = 'Super Strength'
  AND s.XCL_020 > 200
